claims: K-pop blends pop, hip-hop, R&B, and electronic styles.
Major K-pop groups include BTS, BLACKPINK, Stray Kids, and Twice.
The K-pop industry is driven by large agencies like HYBE, SM Entertainment, JYP Entertainment, and YG Entertainment.
HYBE, SM Entertainment, JYP Entertainment, and YG Entertainment oversee the training and production of idol groups.
KPop Demon Hunters is a 2026 Netflix movie.
The soundtrack of KPop Demon Hunters won a Grammy.
